notes:
Added
- Kirinuki now brings the video tools it needs (FFmpeg), four caption fonts (Bangers, Anton, Luckiest Guy and Noto Sans JP) and a short sample video, so it can turn episodes into clips without anything else to install.
- The setup guide has two new steps. Downloads fetches the speech recognition model and, on NVIDIA graphics cards, a library that lets the card do the work, then tunes it for your card once. Test run makes a clip from the sample video so you can see everything works before you use your own episodes.
- The licence list in About now includes FFmpeg and every library built into it, with their licence texts and a link to the complete source code, the caption fonts and the sample video's credits (Tears of Steel, Blender Foundation).
- Import episode on the Home screen: pick an episode you own and Kirinuki copies it into its own work folder, then transcribes it, picks the liveliest moments and makes vertical 1080x1920 clips with word-by-word captions and even loudness. Each job shows its progress, and each clip its frames, times and title, with "Show file" to open it in Explorer.
- Files that can't be used are refused with a plain reason before anything is copied, for example a OneDrive file that is only online, a file over 20 GB, or too little free disk space.
- Transcription and video encoding use your NVIDIA, Intel or AMD graphics card when there is one, and the processor otherwise.
- Settings → Components shows the downloaded parts, with Download, Pause, Resume and Remove.
- Settings → Finished clips opens the folder where Kirinuki keeps every finished clip. Clips stay there when you delete a job.
- Uploads, off by default: send finished clips to YouTube through Zernio or Upload-Post with your own API key, or through YouTube itself in a testing mode that keeps every upload private. Keys are kept in Windows Credential Manager and only their last 4 characters are ever shown. A daily limit and a gap between uploads apply, and an upload whose result is unclear is checked before anything is sent again.
